disagreements.explanation: Model decision boundary variance on near-threshold features. Spark MLlib Random Forest classified as 'Hidden Opportunity', whereas Python XGBoost classified as 'Low Performer' (Actual: 'Low Performer'). Spark utilizes bagging over tree ensembles with sub-sampled feature spaces, while XGBoost utilizes sequential gradient boosting on pseudo-residuals.
